# Time Out Ticketing

> > Official Time Out ticketing platform for booking London's West End theatre shows, major musicals, attractions, and live events across the UK.

Time Out's dedicated ticketing service provides access to London's premier entertainment venues including His Majesty's Theatre, Lyceum Theatre, Victoria Palace Theatre, and Sondheim Theatre. The platform specializes in West End productions featuring world-renowned shows like The Phantom of the Opera, The Lion King, Hamilton, Les Misérables, The Book of Mormon, Mamma Mia!, and My Neighbour Totoro.
